# Repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before changing code, including its shared
Karpathy-inspired coding discipline and applicable engineering standards.
Use the active release plan and spec/plan/tasks/verification as the source of task
status. Keep changes scoped, preserve unrelated work, state material assumptions,
and verify results. Do not treat source/fixture checks as native device acceptance.
These instructions delegate to AGENTS.md, not a separate Copilot policy.
